emma: quick question on the SOC2 audit-export wording. i used 'exports may include derived identifiers' but akiko asked to be explicit about pseudonymization being reversible. thoughts?
raju: agree we should avoid 'anonymize' language. suggest: 'export process may pseudonymize fields; pseudonymization is reversible only if the customer retains the mapping key.'
akiko: legal +1. also please add that exported files are delivered as-is and customers control downstream retention.
emma: updated the line to that exact phrasing and switched example payload to export_ttl_days + redaction_level. pushed the PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1510
marina: tiny nit: use 'export_ttl_days' in examples and add a one-line migration note for older clients using 'ttl_days'.
emma: added migration note.

emma: thanks all, merging after marina approves.
